package fixture

// GREEN: the result is used. Returned, assigned, sent on a channel, or tested
// -- none of these is an expression statement and none is a discard.

import "context"

type proc interface{ Stop(context.Context) error }

func stopAndReturn(p proc, ctx context.Context) error { return p.Stop(ctx) }

func stopAndTest(p proc, ctx context.Context) bool {
	if err := p.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func stopAndSend(p proc, ctx context.Context, errc chan error) {
	go func() { errc <- p.Stop(ctx) }()
}

func stopAndNote(p proc, ctx context.Context, note func(error)) {
	note(p.Stop(ctx))
}
